reason: adoption by init scans relative references, and lint --fix scans code spans, with patterns that scan from every start position, so a note of one long run of "[" or an item ending with one long run of backticks keeps each command running past the 120-second bound of the step (100,000 characters alone take about 30 s). Meanwhile the adoption and fix tests cover ordinary input.
